preparation.situation: Hai người bàn về lễ mừng chiến thắng tại châu Âu khi chiến sự vẫn tiếp diễn ở châu Á.
preparation.objective: Phân biệt lo ngại được nêu trong tranh luận với đánh giá sau đó của nhà sử học.

keyVocabulary.meaning: công nhân sản xuất đạn dược
thực tế trong cách xử lý

transcript: And again, there are a couple of reasons for that. So there’s the, you know, making sure that those still fighting the war didn’t feel forgotten away from Europe. You know, that kind of aspect to it. But there’s also a practical element to it. If these celebrations happen in Europe, if there’s a bank holiday, if everyone, munitions workers get a day off, what does that do for war production and the ability for the Allies to continue fighting in Japan? Does it further delay the end of the war in Southeast Asia? So you know that you have that kind of multifaceted debate, which isn’t just about, you know, ensuring that those still fighting aren’t forgotten, but there’s, you know, the kind of serious, practical considerations of, well, If we celebrate this too much, will people think that the war is done, you know, it’s done with and we can now relax, and we don’t have to focus our efforts on winning the war in Southeast Asia? Yeah. And so what impact then did the European victory have on war production, as you’ve mentioned, and the military’s ongoing efforts? So as I say, you know, that probably, you know, it is a minor impact. And obviously, when the authorities are weighing this up, they’re also quite pragmatic about it. They realise that people are going to celebrate this anyway, you know, even if there’s no kind of official framework to this.

Liệu có kéo dài chiến sự ở Đông Nam Á không?

transcriptSegments.text: They realise that people are going to celebrate this anyway, you know, even if there’s no kind of official framework to this.
transcriptSegments.translationVi: Họ hiểu rằng mọi người vẫn sẽ ăn mừng, dù chẳng có hình thức tổ chức chính thức nào.

questions.prompt: How does the discussion develop across the two speakers’ turns?

options.text: It moves from what officials feared to what the effect probably was
It moves from evidence of losses to a firm estimate of production
It moves from how festivities began to how they were banned
It moves from a military forecast to a proposal for new ceremonies

questions.explanation: Will nhắc các lo ngại đặt ra lúc đó. Chloe hỏi hệ quả thực tế, và Will đánh giá tác động có lẽ nhỏ.

questions.prompt: Which practical consequence was being considered?

options.text: A shortage of venues could stop public celebrations
A pause in munitions work could hamper ongoing operations
Delays in travel could keep soldiers from returning to Europe
Excess military output could make a public holiday unnecessary

questions.explanation: Will đặt giả thiết công nhân sản xuất đạn dược nghỉ lễ có thể ảnh hưởng sản lượng và nỗ lực chiến đấu.

questions.prompt: What is the deeper concern behind “will people think that the war is done”?

options.text: People might mistake a military announcement for an official holiday
People might expect all those overseas to come home immediately
People might see the celebration only as a way to honour service
People might take a regional victory as a signal to ease off the wider war effort

questions.explanation: Ông lo việc ăn mừng có thể tạo cảm giác toàn bộ cuộc chiến đã kết thúc, làm người ở hậu phương giảm tập trung cho nỗ lực còn lại.

questions.prompt: What status does Will give his assessment of the actual impact?

options.text: A tentative judgement that the impact was limited
A finding that the impact was precisely zero
A conclusion that the worst fears had come true
A refusal to discuss the impact at all

questions.explanation: Từ “probably” cho thấy ông đánh giá tác động có lẽ nhỏ và để ngỏ mức độ chắc chắn.

questions.prompt: Why does Will call the authorities “pragmatic”?

options.text: They thought formal celebrations could guarantee greater output
They believed the public would follow any official line
They accounted for public celebrations likely to happen anyway
They treated the remaining fighting chiefly as a symbolic concern

questions.explanation: Việc họ hiểu dân chúng sẽ tự ăn mừng dù thiếu chương trình chính thức giải thích nhận xét “pragmatic”.
